name: L'Oustau de Baumanière

menus.name: La Ballade menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner, last orders 1pm at lunch and 9pm at dinner. Tour de France pairing of 8 half glasses €200, alcohol-free version €120

menus.name: Flânerie menu
menus.note: Tentation pairing of 5 half glasses €120, alcohol-free version €85

menus.name: 1987 Menu Légumes
menus.note: Meat- and fish-free menu from the estate's organic garden. Bucolique pairing of 6 half glasses €135, alcohol-free version €95

alsoTry.name: La Cabro d'Or
alsoTry.note: The estate's other restaurant, with chef Michel Hulin's Provençal cooking: lunch menu €88, Gourmandise menu €145, garden menu €105

bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's Guestonline booking page, or by phone. To book with a gift box, or as a hotel guest, call rather than booking online.
dressCode: Smart dress is required (tenue de ville).
children: There is a children's menu: starter, main and dessert €70, or two courses €50.
